newsitem.title: USA: Biogan settles claims with Idaho officials.
newsitem.headline: Biogan settles claims with Idaho officials.

text.p: Biogan Medical International Inc said it has reached an out-of-court settlement with the State of Idaho Department of Finance concerning allegations that Biogan and one of its directors, Ronald Tolman, violated Idaho securities law.

The charges centered on the the sale of unregistered securities. The settlement prohibits Biogan and Tolman from any future violations, but does not restrict Biogan's business activities in Idaho or elsewhere, Biogan said in a statement.

Biogan also said J. Harold Heaton has been named chief financial officer and operations manager for the Boise office. Heaton comes to Biogan from previous positions with with Sommerset Capital Corp and Quick Shop Minit Mart Inc, a regional convenience store franchisor.

Boise attorney Robert Montgomery has been named corporate secretary, replacing Rulon Tolman who was named vice president of Biogan's medical division. Montgomery had previously been associated with Biogan as legal counsel.
Rulon L. Tolman, currently a member of the Biogan board of directors, will assume duties at Biogan's medical division.
